name: ARMOR-ELECTRICAL
role: Electrical node: reads the voltages, currents, power and energy of the house's AC and DC network, and holds the rules for switching it
stack: C++17 (host-tested core); ESP-IDF firmware for the ESP32-S3 is not written yet
deployment_target: ESP32-S3 nodes inside the electrical panels (firmware to come)
build: cmake -S tests -B build/host && cmake --build build/host && ctest --test-dir build/host
notes: The core (the meters' frames, the bus that asks them, the message, the switching rules) is tested on a computer with stand-in meters and contactors; the messages it makes are accepted by ARMOR-COMMON. There is no firmware yet, nothing has been connected to a meter or a contactor, and nothing here switches anything.
